one_liner: Higgsfield offers a hosted image-and-video generation API, an official MCP connector, and a Composio toolkit.

auth.notes: The REST API uses a key ID and secret. The separate MCP product uses OAuth authorization.

access.notes: This is the closest category for self-service, prepaid access to working generation. Higgsfield says no plan or subscription is required, but developers must fund a balance with a $5 minimum top-up.

api.notes: The reference covers model-specific generation schemas, request status, and cancellation.

mcp.notes: The connector uses OAuth and the signed-in Higgsfield account, separately from API-key billing.

verdict.rationale: Developers can sign up for an API account and use documented generation endpoints. Requests are paid from a prepaid balance, although Higgsfield says no plan or subscription is involved.

evidence.quote: Create and manage API credentials in Higgsfield Console . Each credential consists of a key ID and a secret.
MCP connects through OAuth authorization, no API key is needed. API keys belong to the Higgsfield API, a separate developer product.
Sign up for an API account, either as an individual or as a company. Register a payment method and fund your balance.
Billing is pay-as-you-go from a US dollar balance, and the minimum top-up is $5.
No plan or subscription is involved: fund the balance, send requests at the rates listed in the catalog, and new requests simply wait once the balance hits zero.
The API reference is generated from the public OpenAPI specification. It includes model-specific generation schemas plus the shared status and cancellation operations.
This guide uses the REST API so you can see the complete request lifecycle. It takes about five minutes.
Higgsfield connects to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible agents, with no API key. In Claude, add a custom connector with the URL https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp .
Higgsfield AI provides asynchronous image and video generation APIs powered by multiple creative AI models.
The Higgsfield API lets you generate video and images from your own code: one API key opens every model in the API catalog, and each request is paid in US dollars from a prepaid balance.

problems: The access categories have no exact value for self-service credentials with prepaid usage but no subscription.

The API FAQ describes account creation and credential generation without mentioning payment, while the getting-started article instructs developers to fund the balance before generating a key. The funded route is used because the classification concerns working generation requests.
name: higgsfield

verification.note: The API docs show credentials as a key ID plus secret, so api_key as the only and primary API method is fair. The OAuth quote is explicitly for the separate MCP product, not another recommended API method.

Quotes show self-serve signup but require a payment method and a prepaid balance with a $5 minimum top-up, and they deny any free path. That is not a subscription, which the quotes state outright, but paid_plan is the only defined level for must-pay access with no free or trial path.
A public OpenAPI reference and a quickstart that uses the REST API prove rest and public docs. Generation schemas plus status and cancellation do not contradict moderate breadth.
Higgsfield's own help page tells users to add the connector at https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp now, so official and generally_available are shown. Nothing quoted calls it beta, pilot, or unlaunched.
The cited Composio docs page describes a Higgsfield toolkit for image and video generation APIs.

Documented REST access exists and signup is self-serve, but working requests require funding a prepaid balance, so buildable_with_caveats with main_blocker paid_plan follows from the judged auth, access, and api values.
